title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts: Diagnostic Fee Left to the Holder on a Maintenance Re-decision
content:
For a maintenance re-decision line of a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the diagnostic fee repaid is the part of it the holder was left to pay. The fee is the one on the repaired concern line. The credit is the store's credit of that fee, made by applying the diagnostic fee to the repair, as recorded in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

- **The store credited the fee in part:** the uncredited part is repaid.
- **The store credited the fee in full:** nothing is repaid.
- **Otherwise (no credit):** the whole fee is repaid.

**Illustration (hypothetical fee of 165.00).** A credit of 40.00 leaves 125.00 repaid. A credit of 165.00 leaves 0.00. No credit leaves 165.00.
